svg.title: Crossings, across a cut: what is kept, and what crosses
svg.desc: A cross-section. Claude stands on the left and you on the right. At the top the session, a current of messages, yours and Claude's, cut twice: after each cut a summary takes the conversation's place, the later one retelling the one before, and a small frame crosses beside it. Below, what is said goes down through a mesh that lets words alone pass, into the home: plain files, with no model and no network. There the archive is laid down as sediment, every word under its id, never retold; labels stand in it as stakes, each one sentence of what you tell and ask, never of how you seem, resting on the messages it is about, and one resting on two others as a stack; a gap where Crossings was off holds nothing, and a struck message is gone. Beneath lies the index, a scaffold made from the files. Between the session and the home stands the door, the tools the session reaches through. From the labels and a few of your own words a frame rises and crosses each cut.
svg.text: plain files · no model, no network
down: what is said, word for word
up: a small frame, across each cut
down as what was said; up as a small frame, across each cut
